case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Riporta versione kernel e moduli caricati in ker
case.goal: Riporta versione kernel e moduli caricati in kernel.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `kernel.txt`.
commands: Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select Version; Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPSignedDriver | Select -First 10
